summary: Lewis Hamilton's costly Singapore blunder hands Kimi Antonelli a golden opportunity to clinch the world championship at Circuit of the Americas, where Ferrari's momentum could prove decisive. McLaren and Red Bull battle for supremacy in the constructors' standings as teams recalibrate their strategies following a weekend of miscalculation. A victory for Antonelli would seal the title with races remaining, fundamentally reshaping the championship narrative and cementing Ferrari's resurgence after years of struggle.
